parameters.name: ACL
parameters.description:
The method that is used to verify the identities of clients. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks. In addition, this parameter is available only when the public key of the CA that issues client certificates is enabled. Valid values:

*   **cert**
*   **prefer**
*   **verify-ca**
*   **verify-full** (supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL 12 or later)

parameters.name: CAType
parameters.description:
The type of the server certificate. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs MySQL or PostgreSQL with cloud disks. If you set SSLEnabled to **1**, the default value of this parameter is **aliyun**. Valid values:

*   **aliyun**: a cloud certificate
*   **custom**: a custom certificate

parameters.name: Certificate
parameters.description:
The custom certificate. The custom certificate is in the `PFX` format.

*   Public endpoint: `oss-<The ID of the region>.aliyuncs.com:<The name of the bucket>:<The name of the certificate file (The file name contains the extension.)>`
*   Internal endpoint: `oss-<The ID of the region>-internal.aliyuncs.com:<The name of the bucket>:<The name of the certificate file (The file name contains the extension.)>`

parameters.name: ClientCACert
parameters.description: The public key of the CA that issues client certificates. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks. This parameter must be specified when ClientCAEbabled is set to **1**.

parameters.name: ClientCAEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the public key of the CA that issues client certificates. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks. Valid values:

*   **1**: enables the public key.
*   **0**: disables the public key.

parameters.name: ClientCertRevocationList
parameters.description: The CRL that contains revoked client certificates. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks. This parameter must be specified when ClientCrlEnabled is set to **1**.

parameters.name: ClientCrlEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable a certificate revocation list (CRL) that contains revoked client certificates. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks. In addition, this parameter is available only when the public key of the CA that issues client certificates is enabled. Valid values:

*   **1**: enables the CRL.
*   **0**: disables the CRL.

parameters.name: ConnectionString
parameters.description: The internal or public endpoint for which the server certificate needs to be created or updated.

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: ForceEncryption
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the forceful SSL encryption feature. This parameter is supported only for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances. For more information, see [Configure the SSL encryption feature](~~95715~~). Valid values:

*   **1**: enables the feature.
*   **0**: disables the feature.

parameters.name: ReplicationACL
parameters.description:
The method that is used to verify the replication permission. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks. In addition, this parameter is available only when the public key of the CA that issues client certificates is enabled. Valid values:

*   **cert**
*   **prefer**
*   **verify-ca**
*   **verify-full** (supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL 12 or later)

parameters.name: SSLEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the SSL encryption feature. Valid values:

*   **1**: enables the feature.
*   **0**: disables the feature.

parameters.name: ServerCert
parameters.description: The content of the server certificate. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks. This parameter must be specified when CAType is set to **custom**.

parameters.name: ServerKey
parameters.description: The private key of the server certificate. This parameter is supported only when the instance runs PostgreSQL with cloud disks. This parameter must be specified when CAType is set to **custom**.

parameters.name: TlsVersion
parameters.description: The minimum Transport Layer Security (TLS) version. Valid values: 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. This parameter is supported only for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances. For more information, see [Configure the SSL encryption feature](~~95715~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds modify-db-instance-ssl --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --connection-string rm-uf6wjk50000.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com --ssl-enabled 1 --ca-type aliyun --server-cert -----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----MIID00000QqEP-----END_CERTIFICATE----- --server-key -----BEGIN_PRIVATE_KEY-----MIIE0000ihfg==-----END_PRIVATE_KEY----- --client-ca-enabled 1 --client-ca-cert -----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----MIID00000viXk=-----END_CERTIFICATE----- --client-crl-enabled 1 --client-cert-revocation-list -----BEGIN_X509_CRL-----MIIB000019mg==-----END_X509_CRL----- --acl cert --replication-acl cert --force-encryption 1 --tls-version 1.1 --certificate oss-cn-beijing-internal.aliyuncs.com:zhttest:test.pfx --pass-word zht123456 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds ModifyDBInstanceSSL --region cn-hangzhou --ClientCertRevocationList '-----BEGIN_X509_CRL-----MIIB000019mg==-----END_X509_CRL-----' --ClientCAEnabled 1 --CAType aliyun --ACL cert --PassWord zht123456 --ServerKey '-----BEGIN_PRIVATE_KEY-----MIIE0000ihfg==-----END_PRIVATE_KEY-----' --TlsVersion '1.1' --ServerCert '-----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----MIID00000QqEP-----END_CERTIFICATE-----' --SSLEnabled 1 --DBInstanceId 'rm-uf6wjk50000' --ForceEncryption 1 --ClientCACert '-----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----MIID00000viXk=-----END_CERTIFICATE-----' --ClientCrlEnabled 1 --ReplicationACL cert --ConnectionString 'rm-uf6wjk50000.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com' --Certificate 'oss-cn-beijing-internal.aliyuncs.com:zhttest:test.pfx'
